note: Frozen historical facts for the 377 confirmed flood-attributable animals. The attribution logic itself (which animals qualify) lived only in apa-grants-manager.shelterluv.flood_animals, a view that auto-expired ~2026-10-08 under BigQuery sandbox mode and was never saved elsewhere -- this list IS that attribution decision now, preserved outside BigQuery. Keyed by animalAID (the stable ShelterLuv public ID), not animalInternalID -- one animal (Izzy, AID 196526) only had a placeholder internal ID ('email-196526') at the time this was frozen, from before ShelterLuv's full sync assigned her a real one. The flood response is over and this set is final (confirmed by Joslyn 2026-10-29), so freezing membership here is correct, not a workaround.
